summary: Implemented the PUB-02 public property listing with strict query parsing, filter and sort controls, pagination, browser URL synchronization, safe public projections, responsive locale-aware rendering, SSR bootstrap support, and loading, empty, error, retry, success, permission, and missing-image states.

scopeNotes: The exact local PUB-02 export was used as the visual source reference; no reference image was copied into runtime assets and no production content was fabricated.
The listing consumes only the existing GET /api/v1/public/properties contract and its strict public projection. No mock endpoint or private/provider/audit field is exposed.

apps/web/server.mjs and apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/{app.tsx,entry-client.tsx,entry-server.tsx} are outside the task Allowed Roots but are necessary integration points for the existing SSR/client bootstrap and route rendering; the changes are limited to PUB-02 data and route wiring.
The visual snapshots are generated test artifacts for the selected PUB-02 screen and were regenerated only through the repository Playwright command.
Existing frontend_010 homepage changes and evidence were preserved; overlapping shared files were extended without reverting prior behavior.
knownGaps: Node v22.18.0 is installed while the repository declares Node >=24 <25; all mandatory checks passed on the available runtime, but Node 24 remains unverified.
env:check is blocked because APP_ENV, API_HOST, and API_PORT are absent from the current shell.
No isolated non-production MongoDB/provider topology or credentials were available for live smoke testing.
The public search contract does not provide media URLs, so property cards intentionally render the missing-image state rather than fabricating imagery.
This task does not establish the all-APIs-tested, all-131-screens, full-Backend, or full-platform release claims.
